_note: Source map for the Company A knowledge pack used by Eval Bench. Illustrative corpus for the NRI case exercise, not a reconstruction of any real company's documents. Every entry carries a provenance stamp: BRIEF (stated in the case brief), DERIVED (implied by the brief), SYNTHETIC (authored so a case can run).
_kind_note: Entries are ordered by `kind`, the pack's filing axis: the business subject a support agent searches for. Sections 1-5 (returns_refunds, defects_warranties, marketplace, fulfilment_remedies, goodwill) are live customer policy filed by subject; open_decisions is the governance register; archive is inactive policy kept so version selection is testable. One document, one home: a document with a governance gap still lives under its subject (KB-PTS-01 is filed under returns_refunds) and the open-decisions register indexes it from there. Only KB-PRE-01, a precedence question with no subject home, lives in open_decisions. The canonical order, the heading and the blurb for each section live in knowledge/retriever.py (KIND_ORDER, KIND_HEADING, KIND_BLURB); `kind` is descriptive metadata and never affects retrieval, decisions or scoring.
